items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: And there was another fellow who played nice too, Peter LaCasse. He was a legit trumpet player too.

ctx.x: Yeah, I played with him too. He was a personal friend of mine, he was a nice fellow too. He played nice trumpet too. He was a legit trumpet, no jazz or nothing, he was straight. And there was another fellow who played nice too, Peter LaCasse. He was a legit trumpet player too.
